note: Independent re-audit against RFC 9494 Section 4.2 and current gr.go/gr_state.go (post-18b491ae23). Section 4.2 requires immediate removal of retained stale routes for an LLGR-period family on re-establishment when the new LLGR capability clears F, omits the family, or neither GR nor LLGR is received. Commit 18b491ae23 changed onSessionReestablished so surviving families keep their running LLST timers until EoR (as Section 4.2 requires), while families failing reconnectKeepsFamily (or all families when newCap==nil) still have their LLST timers stopped and are returned in purged for immediate purge-stale dispatch in handleStructuredState. All 7 tagged units verified: positives TestOnSessionReestablished_LLGRFBitClearPurges, TestOnSessionReestablished_FamilyAbsentFromLLGRPurges, TestOnSessionReestablished_NoLLGRCapPurgesLLGRPeriodFamily, and TestOnSessionReestablished_DuringLLGR_NoCaps cover every bullet; negatives TestOnSessionReestablished_DuringLLGR, TestOnSessionReestablished_BothFBitsSetKeepsLLGRPeriodFamily, and TestOnSessionReestablished_GRPeriodFamilyIgnoresLLGRBullets verify keeping both-F-set LLGR families and confining LLGR bullets to families whose LLGR period has begun. Note: TestOnSessionReestablished_DuringLLGR carries a stale doc comment claiming reconnect stops LLST timers, though its assertion only checks purged is empty.
